description: What happened in a server recently, in one call: every channel and thread with new messages since a time (default the last 24 hours), busiest first, with who talked, the messages themselves (trimmed), @everyone pings, and, with mentions_of, the messages that mention a member. Quiet channels are skipped without being read. Read only. For one channel's full history use read_messages.

channels.description: Only these channels (names or IDs); a category means the channels in it. Default: every channel the bot can read.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

hours.description: How far back to look, in hours. Default 24, at most 14 days.

max_channels.description: Most channels and threads read, taking the most recently active. Default 12.

mentions_of.description: A member name or ID; messages that mention them are listed on their own.

per_channel.description: Most messages read per channel. Default 30.

since.description: Or an exact start time in ISO 8601, such as when the user was last here.

name: catch_up
title: Catch up
